_comment: Short interface strings shared by every page. {{ brand }} is filled in from site.json at build time. underButtonNote quotes the WhatsApp pre-fill through {{ whatsappText }}, so the two can never drift apart.

whatsappText.ms: Hai, saya jumpa anda di {{ brand }}.
whatsappText.en: Hi, I found you on {{ brand }}.

underButtonNote.ms: WhatsApp akan dibuka dengan mesej "{{ whatsappText }}" yang sudah ditaip. Anda boleh mengubahnya sebelum menghantar.
underButtonNote.en: WhatsApp opens with "{{ whatsappText }}" already typed. You can edit it before you send.
